claims.claim_text: Passing structured reference image to POST /v1/images/edits reduces character facial drift from 100% to 0% across 6 diverse scenes.
claims.empirical_notes: Demonstrated on character Nour across 6 scenes (ADR-007): Arm A 0/6 pass rate, Arm B 6/6 pass rate.

claims.claim_text: muse-spark-1.3 reliably discriminates matching character candidates from deliberately corrupted candidates using a structured tri-state checklist.
claims.empirical_notes: Correctly returned passed=True on Arm B valid output and passed=False on corrupted test candidate.

image_generation_relevance: Core InkLoop thesis: enforces character identity, style consistency, reference matching, and verifier check.

recipes.expected_outcome: Passes 3/3 checklist items on hair streak, glasses frame, and jacket patch.
failure_observations: Arm A text-only baseline produced 0/6 pass rate.
recipes.intended_outcome: Consistent character portrait with zero facial feature drift.
limitations: Tested on solo character framing; crowd scenes require separate sub-panel segmentation.
recipes.observed_outcome: 6/6 (100%) candidate panels passed canonical verifier checklist.
recipes.reference_requirements: Clean front or 3/4 view PNG reference sheet with transparent or neutral background
required_prompt_components: black and white comic ink, clean linework with screentone shading
Nour, short messy black hair with a single sharp streak of white on the left side
oversized dark hooded jacket with a small yellow lightning bolt patch on the left chest
recipes.use_case: Standard character appearance across story panels.
